source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: Why is the number of installed skills insufficient to determine whether a skill catalog is useful?

options.text: Selection also depends on description quality, overlap, and context use.
options.feedback: The same count can describe clearly separated procedures or a confusing set of overlapping ones. The notes give no universal maximum for useful installed skills.

options.text: Selection depends on the total length of all previous generated outputs.
options.feedback: Past outputs describe particular runs, while selection begins with skill descriptions. Output volume does not establish whether the catalog offers clear, relevant guidance.

options.text: Selection improves whenever more skills cover the same recurring task.
options.feedback: Overlapping coverage can make the intended procedure harder to identify. More entries do not by themselves establish a more useful catalog.

options.text: Selection quality follows from storing the catalog in one project folder.
options.feedback: Project scope can fit local conventions, but storage location does not establish description quality or distinguish overlapping procedures. Assess how the skills fit the work.
